artist.artist_description: 50 Cent, born Curtis Jackson in Queens, New York, is an American rapper known for his gritty lyrics and influential role in the hip-hop genre. Rising to fame with his debut album "Get Rich or Die Tryin'" in 2003, he became a global icon with hits like "In Da Club." Beyond music, 50 Cent has ventured into acting and business, notably surviving a shooting in 2000 that shaped his career and public persona.

track.detail: This song burst onto the scene with an infectious beat that you couldn't help but nod your head to. It was released in 2003, a time when the world was still reeling from the turn of the millennium, and it provided the perfect anthem for celebration and resilience. The artist behind it had a compelling backstory, having survived a shooting that left him with nine bullet wounds, which only added to the song's mystique and his street credibility. The track's success was monumental, reaching the top of the charts and becoming a staple at parties and clubs around the globe. Its cultural impact was undeniable, influencing fashion, dance, and even the way people approached hip-hop music. The song's chorus, simple yet catchy, became a rallying cry for living in the moment and enjoying life's highs.

trackranking.intro: Kicking off at number 1 in our 2000s hip-hop category, 'In Da Club' by 50 Cent is a track that got everyone moving!
